name: shine-notes-app
description: A secure full-stack notes application for the 10Pearls Shine MERN internship.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @shine-notes/backend && npm run build --workspace @shine-notes/frontend
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run db:validate && npm run db:generate && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run build
scripts.format: prettier --write .coderabbit.yaml .github compose.yaml eslint.config.js package.json backend frontend README.md && npm run db:format
scripts.format:check: prettier --check .coderabbit.yaml .github compose.yaml eslint.config.js package.json backend frontend README.md
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @shine-notes/backend && npm run test --workspace @shine-notes/frontend
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --workspace @shine-notes/backend && npm run test:coverage --workspace @shine-notes/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @shine-notes/backend && npm run typecheck --workspace @shine-notes/frontend
